other_conditions: Fresh PhDs/MD/MS candidates within three years of degree completion or holders of provisional degree
Proposed research must be a continuation of the candidate’s PhD/MD/MS work
Maximum age limit 32 years, relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/PH and women candidates
Deserving candidates may receive up to 3 additional years of age relaxation based on prior work, publications, awards, and sponsoring director’s request
PDF guide must have a minimum designation of Scientist‑C grade
Post‑graduate medical students may apply in MCI‑recognised postgraduate medical colleges having at least three graduating batches
Result notification, viva‑voce or thesis submission notifications are not considered
Submission of a plagiarism check report is mandatory
benefits_summary: Monthly fellowship of ₹65,000 plus HRA and NPA, an annual contingency grant of ₹3,00,000 (with 25% usable for travel), and medical benefits as per ICMR rules.
documents_required: Recommendation letter from the Director/Officer‑in‑Charge of the sponsoring ICMR institute/center
